reading.headline: Bank ledger against the statement, 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31: tied at the start and at the end.
reading.scope: This checks the bank ledger only, and takes the ledger named in the file to be a bank account: an income or expense ledger opens at zero for the period, so its gaps would mean nothing. A wrong party or expense ledger is not caught here.
reading.stage: The closing figure counts this file's vouchers as if they were already in the book. Once any of them has been imported, use stage after_post.
